title: BLUMELIFE Clear Gut, Ingredient Army, ACCEPTANCE RUBRIC
frame_timeline: edit/review_frames/sNNN.png at 1fps (NNN-1 = second offset; e.g. s001.png = t=0.0s, s009.png = t=8.0s)
brand_truth: assets/clear_gut_product.png, amber/brown glass dropper bottle, WHITE dropper cap, white+yellow label, 'Clear Gut' in blue text, 'BLUMELIFE' wordmark top, '30 Servings · 30ml'.
definition_of_done: PASS = zero FAILED blockers across all scenes AND the caption/brand layers. Any failed major is triaged by the Director (fix or accept-with-reason). Minors are nice-to-have. needs-human criteria cannot be passed on stills alone, they must be confirmed by a human watching/listening to playback before final sign-off; a needs-human item left unconfirmed blocks final delivery if its severity is blocker.
review_notes: At 1fps a 0.4s crossfade means boundary frames (s008,s015,s023,s031,s038,s046,s053,s061) are BLENDS of two scenes, grade them leniently; do NOT fail a scene on a transition frame. Push identity/grade checks to interior frames.
G-no-burned-text checks the FINAL visible state only; a covered/cropped burned strip will read as clean. Confirm with the editor whether any cover was applied.
CAP-script-correct: diff burned caption text against the .ass source, not OCR-by-eye, for reliable Devanagari matra/conjunct verification.
Lip-sync majors (S1-S5) have no numeric tolerance baked in, Director should pre-agree the fail threshold (e.g. mouth still while audio plays, or visibly off by >~150ms).
engine_failure_modes_anticipated: burned/nonsense on-screen text or auto-captions (Veo's #1 artifact; often garbled Devanagari), negative-checked on EVERY Veo scene S1-S8
Veo animates EVERY visible mouth, multi-mouth talking in any shot with >1 face-bearing subject (S1 stomach, S6 four heroes + stomach, S8 stomach)
fine label-text warp/blank on the bottle in motion (S7 tolerated, S8 sharp-not-legible, S9 is the only guaranteed-legible frame)
character morph / identity drift vs bible across the 8s clip
expression/tone leakage, heroes (esp. Haritaki, whose bible ref is itself fierce) reading menacing instead of benevolent
hand/finger/limb glitches in action poses (S6 fists-up)
audio hard-fail or wrong/garbled line (needs-human transcribe)

global_criteria.text: No model-burned subtitles, captions, watermarks, logos, or gibberish letterforms (Latin or Devanagari) anywhere in any Veo scene S1-S8. The ONLY legitimate text in the finished reel is (a) the intentional gold karaoke caption layer added in post and (b) the S9 product-card tagline/brand.
global_criteria.method: frame@every second s001-s061 (scan each Veo scene)

global_criteria.text: Every frame is vertical 9:16, 1080x1920, no letterbox/pillarbox bars, no aspect distortion or squash.
Consistent glossy 3D Pixar/DreamWorks-caricature look and grade across all scenes (no live-action / 2D / photoreal drift, no per-scene style whiplash beyond the intended warm-vs-dark contrast).
Good-vs-evil reads in under 1s: King = dark/sickly-green/menacing; all four herbs + healthy stomach = bright/warm/friendly. No hero scene is dark or sinister; no King scene is warm/heroic.
0.4s crossfades land on the right neighbors in the right order (S1->S2->...->S9); no scene out of order, no hard jump-cut where a crossfade is specified, no black gap.
One continuous ambient/music bed with no abrupt dropouts at scene seams; narration/dialogue audio is intelligible above the bed.
Re-transcribing the full reel yields the 8 scripted lines (S1-S8) in script order, each matched to its scene window, clean Hindi pronunciation, no swapped/dropped/duplicated lines.

caption_layer_criteria.text: Gold karaoke Devanagari captions are present across the dialogue/narration of S1-S8 (the intended burned caption layer).
Caption text per scene matches the verbatim Devanagari script line for that scene (no typos, no transliteration, no wrong-scene line, correct Devanagari conjuncts/matras).
caption_layer_criteria.method: final-only frame@one readable frame per scene s003,s011,s019,s027,s035,s043,s050,s057 + transcribe

caption_layer_criteria.text: Captions render in the intended gold styling, legible against the background (sufficient contrast / outline), not clipped at frame edges.
Caption baseline is placed in the lower-third clear of the speaker's face/mouth and clear of the product bottle (does not occlude the label in S7/S8/S9).
Karaoke highlight fill advances roughly in time with the spoken words (not static, not wildly out of sync).
Only the intentional gold caption is present, it is NOT stacked on top of a Veo-burned caption (no doubled/overlapping subtitle strips).

brand_fidelity_criteria.text: S9 product card shows the REAL bottle (assets/clear_gut_product.png) with a fully legible label: 'BLUMELIFE' wordmark, 'Clear Gut' in blue, dropper cap, amber bottle, label undistorted. This is the one guaranteed-legible brand frame.
S9 burned tagline reads exactly 'पेट हल्का। दिन हल्का।' plus the BLUMELIFE Clear Gut brand, correct Devanagari, clean placement, no typo.
The stylized bottle in S7/S8 matches the real product's colorway, amber/brown glass, white dropper cap, yellow/white label zone, recognizably the same product even though stylized.
No competing/incorrect product, no pill/tablet/capsule, no different bottle shape (e.g. a spray or jar) substituted for the dropper bottle in any scene.

scenes.line: हा हा हा! मैं हूँ कॉन्स्टिपेशन किंग! तुम्हारा पेट मैं कभी साफ़ नहीं होने दूँगा!

The stomach appears ONLY as a small dim turned-away silhouette/shadow at the lower frame edge with NO visible face and NO visible mouth.
Only the King's mouth moves while speaking; the shadow-stomach has no mouth that moves (no second talking mouth).
King faces the camera (talking to lens), low-angle medium framing, slow push-in.
Dark gut-cave, sickly-green gas, hard top-light, villain grade reads evil.
No model-burned subtitles/captions/gibberish text anywhere in frame.
King's identity (crown, body form, face) is stable start-to-end; no morph/drift vs bible.
Audio is the exact scripted Hindi line in a deep gravelly comically-villainous voice, clean pronunciation, line starts after a brief pause.
King's lip movement matches the spoken line (acceptable sync).
